name: Abandoned Alley
source:
After work, Barry decides to walk along an abandoned alley to shorten the way to the house where his family was waiting for him. But he didn't know what this path was hiding and what lay ahead.

[From [url=https://morlo.itch.io/aba]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
下班后，巴里决定抄近路，穿过一条废弃小巷，回到家人正在等待的屋子。可他不知道，这条路隐藏着什么，前方又有什么等待着他。

[摘自[url=https://morlo.itch.io/aba]Itch.io[/url]]
